source.source_locator: 教則 第4章 4.1「飛行機」機体の特徴

evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 飛行機型はホバリング・後進・真横への移動ができず横方向へ進むにはバンクして旋回する。
evidence.tested_misconception: 飛行機型はマルチローターと同様に機首方向を変えず真横へ移動できる。
evidence.reasoning_path: fixed-wing lift/forward-flight constraint -> reject hover/reverse/lateral translation -> bank to change horizontal direction

collision.note: Tier A。既存固定翼問は最低速度・滑空・操舵面等が中心で横移動の運動制約は別命題。

independent_review.rationale: Explicit fixed-wing motion constraint not answer-defining elsewhere: no direct lateral translation; horizontal direction change requires a banked turn. Existing fixed-wing questions cover minimum speed, glide and control-surface axes, not this lateral-movement rule.

director_adjudication.rationale: Adopt the independent review because it applies the full-canonical collision gate required by the 400-question quality contract. Drop the 16 rejected candidates without replacement; the B13 ceiling is not a quota. Retain C002 for the source-defined fixed-wing lateral-movement constraint and bank-turn solution. Retain C009 as a materially distinct large-multirotor ground-effect boundary variant relative to Q132. Retain C014 because the Ah = A × h relationship is not answer-defining in the current canonical bank; Q159 overlap is contextual only. Retain C020 for source-defined antenna directionality and operational orientation. Reject C007 because Q149 already embeds the same opposite-rotation reaction-torque balance mechanism and the extra density is not justified. No HUMAN review is claimed.
